_doc: Release identity of the dual-host harness. Both native manifests, the build marker and the release bundle read name/version from here; nothing else declares a version. `marketplace_source` + `release_ref` name the git marketplace channel projects install from; scripts/release-harness.mjs publishes to it.
name: harness
description: Planning and review procedures (prime, brainstorm, plan-feature, setup-start, handoff) with fail-closed cross-model review, packaged for Claude Code and Codex CLI from one source.
